visual_en: A tiny, highly detailed cyborg chef with short golden fiber hair and glowing golden lens eyes. The character wears a pristine white oriental chef's outfit adorned with lavish golden embroidery and a flowing golden particle aura. Floating around the head are golden cooking utensils and a massive, radiant golden wok that emits sparks of energy. On the back, a small golden treasure chest serves as a bag. The feet are clad in white straw-style boots with intricate gold metallic joints. The entire silhouette is defined by the large floating wok and the shimmering golden rift effects emanating from the character's center.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing confidently while spinning a massive golden wok with a calm, professional stance.
vfx_en: Golden spatial fractures and shimmering gold dust particles swirling in a circular motion.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
